clock_waveform.sata_link_clock_gen1: 1.5 GHz embedded clock recovered from 1.5 Gbps 8b/10b stream.
clock_waveform.sata_link_clock_gen2: 3.0 GHz embedded clock recovered from 3 Gbps 8b/10b stream.
clock_waveform.sata_link_clock_gen3: 6.0 GHz embedded clock recovered from 6 Gbps 8b/10b stream.

COMRESET.burst_envelope: Each burst is 160 UI of activity (4 ALIGN primitives, 16 Dwords-worth) followed by 480 UI of inaccurate idle, repeated 6 times.
COMRESET.purpose: Reset PHY of the attached device; software triggers via PxSCTL.DET=1 then back to 0.

COMINIT.purpose: Device response indicating presence + readiness to begin training.

COMWAKE.burst_envelope: Each burst is 160 UI active, separated by 160 UI idle.
COMWAKE.purpose: Final OOB handshake before bit-lock + speed negotiation.

fis_frame_waveform.payload: FIS Type byte + FIS body Dwords, 8b/10b encoded

primitive_align_waveform.frequency: Periodic clock-compensation insertion during continuous transmission.

flow_control_waveform_hold_holda.scenario: Inside a Data FIS, transmitter / receiver runs short.
flow_control_waveform_hold_holda.transmitter_action: Send HOLD primitive in place of payload Dword.

command_issue_timing.step_2_hba_fetch: HBA fetches Command Header (32 B) at PxCLB[CCS].
command_issue_timing.step_3_hba_fetch_CT: HBA fetches Command Table at CTBA.
command_issue_timing.step_4_hba_xmit_CFIS: HBA sets PxTFD.STS.BSY=1 and transmits CFIS.
command_issue_timing.step_6_clear_BSY: If Command Header C=1, HBA clears PxTFD.STS.BSY.
command_issue_timing.step_7_data_phase: Data FIS transferred per W bit + PRDT.
command_issue_timing.step_8_d2h: Device returns D2H Register FIS with I bit.

power_state_entry_exit_waveform.Active_to_Partial: PMREQ_P from host (or device); receiver responds PMACK; both PHYs enter Partial; ~10 µs exit.
power_state_entry_exit_waveform.Active_to_Slumber: PMREQ_S; PMACK; both PHYs enter Slumber; ~10 ms exit.
power_state_entry_exit_waveform.Slumber_to_DevSleep: Host asserts DEVSLP sideband HIGH; PxSSTS.IPM transitions to 8h.
power_state_entry_exit_waveform.DevSleep_to_Active: Host de-asserts DEVSLP LOW; device wakes within PxDEVSLP.DETO.

timing_tables_referenced: Section 5.3 HBA Port State Machine timing arcs
PxDEVSLP DITO / MDAT / DETO fields define the DevSleep envelope
general_timing_rule: AHCI does not define raw register-access setup/hold. SATA Transport / Link / PHY carries line-rate timing (Serial ATA 2.6). Software polls registers to observe state transitions.
